ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Daycare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of federal funds to Minnesota daycare centers and identify any potential shell companies or individuals involved in the fraud.
questions: How did the fraudulent daycare centers receive federal funds?
Who are the individuals involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the extent of the fraud and identify the individuals involved. This story has the potential to expose a large-scale scam and bring those responsible to justice.
